title: Chapter 585 - 585 Advanced Fire Control Technique; Heavenly Hound Attacks!
content:
Chapter 585 - 585 Advanced Fire Control Technique; Heavenly Hound Attacks!

Chapter 585 - 585 Advanced Fire Control Technique; Heavenly Hound Attacks!

585 Advanced Fire Control Technique; Heavenly Hound Attacks!

Beside the Bamboo Green Python was an ancient chest.

Lin Fan opened it.

A ball of light flashed with a dazzling light.

An emotionless voice sounded in his ears.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Fire Control Technique. Do you want to use it?]

After this voice sounded, Hua Nation’s live broadcast room was in an uproar.

Xiao Bing: [Beginner Fire Control Technique? Could this be like those divine techniques from novels and movies?]

Reborn: [F*ck! God Lin is awesome!]

Human: [You said that there are no gods in this world?]

Untimely: [God Lin, you’re going to cultivate!]

Concentration: [Awesome!]

…

Compared to the excitement of the people in the live stream, Lin Fan was very familiar with the light ball in the box.

That was because a crisp voice rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packet—Advanced Fire Control Technique!]

Then, Lin Fan felt his body warm up.

Suddenly, in his vision, the trees, grass, and even the air were filled with special fire elements.

With just a thought, these fire elements would all burst into flames. It was very magical.

After a moment of comprehension, Lin Fan’s gaze landed on the light ball in the box.

He did not touch the ball but turned to the Heavenly Hound and asked, “Do you want this Beginner Fire Control Technique?”

After all, Lin Fan had already obtained the Advanced Fire Control Technique. This Beginner Fire Control Technique was no longer of any use to him.

…

In fact, when the Heavenly Hound first saw the ball of light, it was attracted by it.

It instinctively wanted to get the ball of light.

After hearing Lin Fan’s words, the Heavenly Hound nodded its head reflexively.

Lin Fan said, “Alright, just touch it.”

The Heavenly Hound responded and slowly walked forward.

Then, it placed its claws on it.

The ball of light turned into a stream of light and instantly entered the Heavenly Hound’s body.

The next moment, the Heavenly Hound opened its mouth and spat out a fireball the size of a basketball.

The scorching flames quickly burned the withered grass in front.

In Hua Nation’s live broadcast room.

Little Teenager: [F*ck! God Lin gave the skill to the Heavenly Hound just like that?]

Delin: [No!]

He Yongchen: [No!]

Chen Shuai: [God Lin, even if you don’t want the fire control technique, you shouldn’t have given it to the Heavenly Hound. Why didn’t you give it to me?]

Waiting for Your Return: [Such a divine skill was directly given to a ferocious beast? This…]

God: [Sigh, what a waste.]

…

Yuan Yuan was once a famous writer.

A few years ago, she bought a house in Nashland and successfully obtained a Nashland household registration.

However, after entering the Nashland, Yuan Yuan realized that the real Nashland was not as beautiful as she had imagined.

She regretted it and was helpless.

However, she still stayed in Nashland.

Firstly, as long as one obtained another country’s household registration, they would automatically lose their Hua Nation household registration. It would be extremely difficult to change back to Hua Nation household registration.

Secondly, Yuan Yuan did not want the people in Hua Nation to feel that she was living a bad life.

She wanted others to be envious and look up to her life!

When the doomsday declaration appeared, Nashland announced many heroes.

Among them, there were athletes, artists, and warriors.

Meanwhile, Hua Nation had yet to discover any heroes.

This made Yuan Yuan very happy.

Because she was now a Nashland citizen. The more heroes Nashland had, the easier it would be to survive the apocalypse. The country might even become more prosperous.

Hua Nation was the exact opposite.

As a result, her friends, family, and fans in Hua Nation became more and more envious of her.

Unfortunately, the good times did not last long.

After the heroes arrived in the Otherworld, Hua Nation’s hero also appeared on the screen… Lin Fan!

In the beginning, Yuan Yuan looked down on Lin Fan.

However, not long after, Lin Fan had killed two ferocious beasts.

Then, as if he had obtained the power of a god, he easily killed the Giant Crocodile and the Bamboo Green Snake…

It allowed the people of Hua to gain benefits such as increasing their lifespan, improving their air quality, increasing their freshwater, increasing their oil, and so on.

This made Yuan Yuan very unhappy with Lin Fan.

Because she was no longer a Hua citizen, she could not enjoy these benefits.

Jealousy and hatred were surging wildly in her heart.

At this moment, Yuan Yuan, who was in America, was even more displeased when she saw the audience in the live broadcast room praising Lin Fan.

Hence, she logged into Weibo and posted an article.

Yuan Yuan: [My disappointment.

[When I saw a hero appear in Hua Nation and how he continuously killed ferocious beasts with luck, I was filled with confidence in him.

[However, I didn’t expect him to become arrogant and complacent because of this!

[The Beginner Fire Control Technique will truly make one a god.

[In the end, he gave it to a ferocious beast.

[Yes!

[People should be kind and generous.

[However, now isn’t the time for that!

[Although this ferocious beast is relatively easy to get along with now.

[No one knows if it’ll suddenly attack Lin Fan!

[Lin Fan is deep in a dangerous foreign world.

[His safety not only represents one person but also the entire Hua Nation and the entire world!

[Pride makes one fail!]

Yuan Yuan’s works were very popular in the past, so she had many fans.

Not long after her Weibo post was posted, many people shared and commented on it.

…

Lin Fan had no idea about the bullet comments and Yuan Yuan’s article.

He had just obtained Advanced Fire Control Technique, so he was in a good mood. His footsteps became lighter.

The Heavenly Hound that had been following behind him could not help but close the distance between him and Lin Fan.

Not long after, another crisp notification sounded out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! You’ve been in the Otherworld for 120 hours. Congratulations, you’ve received 300 Constitution points.]

Lin Fan’s body squirmed slightly as his strength increased once again.

The sun slowly set.

Just as Lin Fan was about to find a place to rest…

Not far away, a three-meter-tall grizzly bear slowly poked its head out of the woods.

Roar!

The grizzly bear roared toward the sky, and the entire mountain forest shook with it. It was extremely terrifying.

When the grizzly bear saw Lin Fan, its lantern-like eyes turned scarlet.

Then, it opened its mouth wide and rushed toward Lin Fan like a speeding truck. It wanted to crush Lin Fan into meat paste.

Lin Fan’s expression did not change at all. He just stood there calmly.

Just as he was considering whether or not to draw his sword, the Heavenly Hound behind him suddenly let out a wild bark.

Then, his body suddenly grew to three meters tall. He arrived in front of Lin Fan in an instant.

Then, he swung his claw.

Its sharp claws slashed through the air.

When the Heavenly Hound’s claws touched the giant bear’s body, it was as if it had touched a piece of tofu. The bear instantly exploded, and hot blood spurted out crazily!

The giant bear, which had been so imposing earlier, fell to the ground stiffly. It lost all its vitality.
